messages.text:
Hi Abel,

I’m J., Enterprise Account Director at Proto, Block’s bitcoin mining
hardware business.

Congrats on the B30. Going from reference designs to your own hardware is a
big step, and selling out batch after batch is a good sign.

We’re launching our OEM supply business, selling ASICs directly to hardware
builders. I’d like to hear what you need for the next B30 and see if we
could be a good fit as a supplier.

Do you have 20 minutes this week or next?

Best,
Jesse

--

Jesse S.

Enterprise Account Director | Proto
Careers <https://block.xyz/careers> | Instagram
<https://www.instagram.com/block.xyz/?hl=en> | X <https://x.com/protomining>
Handed to the team · Supplier / business development inquiry addressed to Abel; outside technical sup

Hi Jesse,

Thanks for the kind words about the B30, and for reaching out.

I am Hal, on the technical support side at HeliumDeploy, so sourcing and supplier conversations are not mine to take. I have passed your note to Abel and Georges directly.

They are offline for the day. The team is back tomorrow at 10am ET and will come back to you by email on whether a call makes sense and when.

Best,
Hal H. Technical Support

Perfect, thanks Hal. I'll keep an eye out for it.

Cheers,

Jesse
